confirmation_lifecycle_contract.contract: A newly observed human may exist before a positive public tracker identity is emitted. Identity -1 / unconfirmed is NEVER exposed: it is filtered before becoming a dict key. No placeholder identity is invented to imitate legacy.
confirmation_lifecycle_contract.evidence: frame-1 fabrication and -1 leakage asserted on synthetic fixtures; confirmation itself evidenced on the three VAL sequences (25/24/31 identities, median track lengths 298/94/58)

downstream_audit.finding: every consumer iterates frame_tracks.items() and consumes the keys present, so an unconfirmed frame yields an empty dict rather than a -1 player. No component assumes a positive id on first observation, and none required a fix.

public_detection_vs_identity: EyeCU already emitted only TRACKED humans -- the pre-existing data contract is tracked-only output, unchanged by this switch. An accepted detection whose identity is unconfirmed is withheld for that frame, exactly as a sub-threshold tracked box already was. Ball is unaffected and still reported from frame 1 via its own isolated path.

test_classification.note: the 7 ball-isolation tests are fixture-assumption cases whose invariants are separately asserted for BOTH backends on 8-frame fixtures in test_cbiou_integration

edge_case.summary: CBIoU track ids are 0-BASED; the EyeCU filter discards id 0 as if it were unconfirmed.

root_cause.location: trackers/football_tracker.py -- `if raw_id is None or int(raw_id) <= 0: continue`
root_cause.fact: CBIoUTracker emits ids 0, 1, 2, ... and uses -1 for a track that has not met minimum_consecutive_frames. sv.ByteTrack is 1-based, so the `<= 0` guard was written for legacy semantics and silently drops CBIoU's first track.
root_cause.classification: EyeCU INTEGRATION BUG -- not upstream behaviour, not fixture pathology

edge_case.my_earlier_explanation_was_wrong: I reported the stationary synthetic fixture as "CBIoU never confirms it". It confirms immediately as id 0; my filter then removed it. Motion was never the variable -- all four regimes (identical box, 1px jitter, 1px/frame, modest motion) return id 0 on every frame.

scope.effect: one genuine identity withheld per sequence while it holds id 0

edge_case.metrics_impact: The T2 reference runner used the same `<= 0` filter, so reference-vs-integrated equivalence is genuine and the bake-off comparison was internally consistent. But the frozen HOTA/AssA/IDF1 describe the FILTERED output, so they under-count CBIoU slightly rather than flattering it.
edge_case.not_done: No fix applied, no tuning, no default change -- audit only, per instruction.
edge_case.recommended: change the predicate to < 0, re-run equivalence and the T2 metrics, and re-freeze; CBIoU configuration itself must not change

corrected_selection.note: CBIoU wins on both branches: higher COMBINED_SEQ HOTA and lower cost. BoTSORT has no paired end-to-end measurement, so its criterion 8 is unestablished and it could not be selected without one.

adapter: raw < 0 dropped; raw >= 0 -> public id raw + 1 (modern only; legacy untouched)
selection_branch: exactly one candidate passed ALL nine criteria
